'''Biri''', also known as '''Biria''', '''Birri Gubba''', '''Birigaba''', '''Perembba''' and other variants, is a dialect of the [[Australian Aboriginal languages|Australian Aboriginal language]] [[Biri language|of the same name]] formerly spoken along the [[Bowen River (Queensland)|Bowen River]] in the state of [[Queensland]], by the [[Birri Gubba]] people.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Breen |first=Gavan |date=January 2009 |title=The Biri Dialects and their Neighbours |url=https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/03721426.2009.10887121 |journal=Transactions of the Royal Society of South Australia |language=en |volume=133 |issue=2 |pages=219–256 |doi=10.1080/03721426.2009.10887121 |issn=0372-1426|url-access=subscription }}</ref>

* {{IPAslink|d̪}} is realized as {{IPAblink|ð}} intervocalically and word-initially before {{IPAslink|a}} and {{IPAslink|i}}.
* {{IPAslink|g}} becomes {{IPAslink|w}} before and after {{IPAslink|u}}.
* {{IPAslink|n}} and {{IPAslink|l}} are realized somewhat retroflex before and after {{IPA|/u/}}.<ref name=":1" />

=== Vowels ===
Vowels are noted as /a, i, u/. Vowels are raised and fronted before palatals and backed before {{IPA|/w/}}.

Long {{IPA|/aː/}} occurs in only two words, being {{Lang|bzr|waːga}} 'work', an English loan, and {{Lang|bzr|gaːgini}} 'Reg Dodd', a personal name.<ref name=":1">{{Cite book|title=Biri|last=Terrill|first=Angela|year=1998}}</ref>
